preconditions.expression: isinstance(T, int) and T >= 1 and T <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(X, int) and isinstance(Y, int) and abs(X) <= 10**9 and abs(Y) <= 10**9 for X, Y in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, X and Y are integers with absolute values at most 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == (0 if diff == 0 else (1 if diff % 2 != 0 else 2)) for i, diff in enumerate([Y - X for X, Y in test_cases]))
postconditions.description: For each test case with difference diff = Y - X, the output is 0 if diff is 0, 1 if diff is odd, and 2 if diff is non-zero and even. This represents the minimum rounds using one odd integer a and one even integer b.
